'''Fire emeralds''' were a type of valuable emeralds.<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> 

Sometime before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] failed to recover a shipment of fire emeralds when it was swallowed by the [[Khadaji Singularity/Legends|Khadaji Singularity]].<ref name="JT" />
